gigoteuses.title: Baby bamboo sleep bag — the secret to a peaceful night
p: The bamboo sleep bag has become the must-have piece of the first months. Safer than a duvet — not recommended before 12 months according to paediatric guidelines — the M!LK tie sleep bag wraps baby with no smothering risk while leaving their arms free and their legs at ease. The bamboo sleep bag replaces the sheet and blanket with a single baby sleeping bag that stays in place all night, even when your newborn moves.

Our sleep bag is made of bamboo jersey, a naturally temperature-regulating fabric: it releases excess heat when baby is warm and limits night sweating. Its breathable fibre stays with baby's body all night long.

Its TOG rating of 0.5 to 1 makes it a light-to-versatile sleep bag, ideal for a room between 20 and 27°C — most heated rooms, all year round. If your room is cooler, layering is the rule: a long-sleeve bodysuit and a pyjama under the sleep bag adjust the warmth without ever overloading baby.

Every M!LK sleep bag is certified OEKO-TEX Standard 100, the strictest textile standard in the world, which tests for more than 100 harmful substances. Atopic, sensitive or eczema-prone skin fully benefits from bamboo, hypoallergenic and naturally antibacterial. Available in 0-3 months and 3-6 months, with a tie system that opens one-handed in the dark — designed for quiet night-time changes.

Our unisex prints (Éclair, Smileys, Damier, Terracotta) were designed to break away from blue-and-pink gendered codes and take baby from everyday to outings. The M!LK tie sleep bag is also a useful, lasting new-baby gift idea — the one that gets used every evening for 6 months, not forgotten at the back of a drawer.

pyjamas.title: Baby bamboo pyjamas — softness and freedom of movement
p: Baby bamboo pyjamas combine two demands that are hard to reconcile: extreme softness for a newborn's ultra-fine skin, and a real hold that follows movement without pulling, squeezing or pilling. Our bamboo sleepsuit is built with 4-way stretch that adapts to a fast-growing body, and flat seams that eliminate rubbing during sleep.

Bamboo is 3× softer than ordinary cotton because its microfibres are naturally round, with no rough edges. For a baby sleepsuit worn 10 to 14 hours a day, this difference in softness transforms the newborn's tactile experience. The fabric also stays cooler in summer and warmer in winter, thanks to bamboo's passive thermoregulation, making it a 4-season baby pyjama.

Our newborn sleepsuit features a double reversed zip for night-time changes — no more press-studs to line up at 3 a.m. while baby cries. Changing is done from the bottom to keep the chest warm, and the zip pulls back up without waking the newborn. Built-in foldable mittens protect little hands from scratches during the sensitive weeks, then fold away when baby learns to grasp.

All our newborn baby pyjamas are certified OEKO-TEX Standard 100. Available in Newborn, 0-3 months and 3-6 months sizes, with modern unisex prints designed for parents looking for something other than pastel teddy bears. Practical, lasting, beautiful baby pyjamas — no compromise.

bodies.title: Baby bamboo bodysuit — the foundation of any 0-6 months wardrobe
p: The baby bamboo bodysuit is the first layer of a newborn's wardrobe, the one you put on at wake-up and take off at bedtime — sometimes several times a day because of leaks and spit-ups. That's why you need plenty of them, and why you want them flawless: soft on the skin, easy to put on, hard-wearing in the wash. Our OEKO-TEX bodysuit meets these three criteria with no compromise.

Bamboo is naturally antibacterial, which reduces odours and irritation on a newborn's delicate skin. The fabric breathes better than cotton and limits sweating, which is crucial for a baby bodysuit worn as a base layer against the skin, sometimes for 12 hours straight. The fibre is also 3× softer and stretchier, so the bodysuit follows baby's movements without squeezing at the crotch or leaving marks.

The widened envelope neckline slips on without forcing over the head, with no pressure on the fontanelle, and the press-studs between the legs allow a quick change without taking everything off. The long-sleeve baby bodysuit protects at night alongside the sleep bag, while the short-sleeve bodysuit dresses everyday wear as soon as it's mild. Our styles come in Newborn, 0-3 months and 3-6 months to cover the first six months.

Our Éclair, Smileys and Damier prints are unisex and coordinated with the rest of the M!LK collection — a unisex baby bodysuit that doesn't look like all the others. Perfect as a multi-pack new-baby gift or to round out a baby registry, the OEKO-TEX certified bamboo bodysuit is the best-value investment of the first months.

langes.title: Baby bamboo muslin — multi-purpose and ultra-absorbent
p: The baby bamboo muslin is the most versatile accessory in a newborn's whole wardrobe. One large bamboo muslin square (120×120 cm at M!LK) serves in turn to swaddle, cover baby in the pram, make an improvised nursing pillow, an XXL bib, a travel mattress protector, a bath cape or a light blanket. One fabric, dozens of everyday uses.

Bamboo has an absorption capacity 40% higher than cotton, which makes it the ideal material for baby muslins: a single square soaks up an entire spit-up, dries quickly and stays soft against a newborn's skin. The fibre woven into bamboo muslin creates a light, supple weave that softens further with every wash — unlike cotton gauze, which stiffens.

For swaddling, the XXL size is essential: it recreates the enveloping feel of the womb without slipping at the first wriggle. Combined with a light textured grip, our baby bamboo muslin stays in place even when baby squirms, which soothes evening crying and eases falling asleep. The fabric is OEKO-TEX Standard 100, machine-washable at 30°C, and keeps its softness for years.

The M!LK baby muslin square comes in a Terracotta shade, neutral and warm, that suits every skin tone and coordinates with the rest of the collection. It's also the most useful new-baby gift — the one everyone wants after trying it once, to give as a pair or trio on a baby registry.

accessoires.title: Baby bamboo accessories — the little details that make all the difference
p: Baby bamboo accessories round out a newborn's wardrobe with the details that genuinely change daily life: a baby bamboo hat that stays put without squeezing, a baby head bow that doesn't fall off, unisex pieces that coordinate with the M!LK collection. The newborn hat remains an essential for the first weeks: the head accounts for around 20% of a newborn's body surface and is their main source of heat loss.

Our bamboo hat is designed to hug the shape of the head without pressure on the fontanelle, still fragile through the first six months. Bamboo fibre is naturally thermoregulating: it holds warmth when the air is cool and stays breathable when baby overheats. The OEKO-TEX Standard 100 fabric is guaranteed free of harmful substances, which is crucial for an accessory in direct contact with the particularly sensitive skin of the scalp.

The baby head bow adds a soft, modern graphic touch, with nothing compressive. More versatile than a plastic headband, chicer than a plain hat, it's the accessory that turns an everyday outfit into a special outing (baby shower, newborn photo, baby's first appointment). Our Terracotta version, in the signature M!LK palette, coordinates with the bodysuits, pyjamas and sleep bags for complete looks.

All our newborn accessories are made from the same OEKO-TEX certified bamboo fibre as the rest of the collection. Machine-washable at 30°C, they keep their softness and shape for months. Ideal as an extra new-baby gift or to complete a baby registry that's already well stocked with pieces that stand out.

gigoteusesFaq.title: Everything about the bamboo tie sleep bag

faq.q: What is a tie sleep bag?
faq.r: A simple tie closure, no zip or buttons. You untie, you change, you re-tie. Fast, even in the dark. The M!LK tie sleep bag is made of OEKO-TEX certified bamboo — ultra-soft, thermoregulating, ideal from birth.

faq.q: Why a tie sleep bag rather than a zip?
faq.r: Most sleep bags close with a zip. We chose ties, for two reasons. Safety: no zip that could catch baby's delicate skin, no pull-tab near the face, no small detachable parts — just soft fabric and ties. Adjustability: the ties adjust to baby's size; where a zip sleep bag quickly becomes too small, ours keeps up with your child's growth for longer.

faq.q: Does the sleep bag's envelope neckline really go on without forcing?
faq.r: Yes — and above all, it doesn't go over the head. The envelope neckline is designed to put the garment on from the bottom, gently sliding it up baby's body. This avoids any pressure on the head and the fontanelle, and makes dressing far simpler, especially with a newborn.

faq.q: What are the sleep bag's built-in mittens for?
faq.r: To prevent scratches without dealing with separate mittens you're forever losing. They're built in: you fold them over, you fold them back, they're always there. You can leave them open when it's warm — the bamboo fabric regulates temperature naturally.

faq.q: Is the bamboo sleep bag warm enough for baby?
faq.r: Our sleep bag has a TOG rating of 0.5 to 1: light to versatile, ideal for a room between 20 and 27°C. The bamboo jersey regulates temperature — it releases excess heat and limits sweating. If the room is cooler, layer up: a long-sleeve bodysuit or a pyjama under the sleep bag adjusts the warmth without overloading baby.

faq.q: Is the sleep bag OEKO-TEX certified?
faq.r: Yes. All M!LK products are certified OEKO-TEX Standard 100 — no harmful substances, tested for newborn skin. The bamboo sleep bag is designed for babies from birth to 6 months.
Its smooth fibre regulates temperature naturally — it helps baby stay at the right temperature all night. And unlike cotton, it gets softer with every wash.

faq.q: How do I choose the right sleep bag size?
faq.r: The stretch bamboo fabric is extremely elastic. If you're hesitating between two sizes, take the larger one to extend its use. M!LK sleep bags are available in Newborn (0-1 month) and 0-3 months.

peauSensible.title: Clothes for babies with sensitive skin
peauSensible.intro: A newborn's skin is up to 5 times thinner than ours. Everything in constant contact with it matters: the material, the seams, the textile's chemical treatments. For fragile or reactive skin, the choice of clothing is no small detail.

sections.p: Rough fibres that rub. Hard seams against the neck and armpits. And above all, the chemical substances that many textiles retain after dyeing and treatment.

Bamboo (viscose) is a smooth, soft fibre — it glides over the skin instead of irritating it. It's naturally breathable and thermoregulating, so baby sweats less (and sweat keeps irritation going). And OEKO-TEX Standard 100 certification guarantees the absence of the harmful substances it tests for: that's what matters most for reactive skin.

peauSensible.disclaimer: Note: we're talking about comfort and softness for fragile/reactive skin. We don't promise to treat any medical condition — eczema is managed with a doctor.
peauSensible.details_p: Flat seams, envelope neckline (no pressure on the neck), built-in mittens on the bodysuits (baby doesn't scratch themselves).

faq.q: Is bamboo suitable for eczema-prone skin?
faq.a: It's a soft material, certified free of harmful substances, often well tolerated by reactive skin. For diagnosed eczema, ask your paediatrician for advice.
No. It guarantees the absence of harmful substances, not organic origin.

sections.title: 4. Legal basis
sections.content: The processing of your data is based on the performance of the sales contract (orders), your consent (newsletter), and our legal obligations (accounting).

sections.title: 5. Retention period
sections.content:
Order data: 10 years (accounting obligation)
Account data: until the account is deleted
Newsletter data: until unsubscription

sections.title: 6. Data sharing
sections.content:
Your data may be shared with:
- Stripe (payment processing) — privacy policy available at stripe.com
- Sendcloud (shipping) — to generate delivery labels
- Resend (transactional emails)
- Vercel (site hosting)
- Only after your consent: Google and Meta (audience measurement & advertising — see "8. Cookies and trackers")
No data is sold. Any transfer for audience-measurement or advertising purposes (Google, Meta) requires your prior consent, which can be withdrawn at any time.

sections.title: 7. Your rights
sections.content:
In accordance with the GDPR, you have the following rights:
- Right of access to your data
- Right to rectification
- Right to erasure ("right to be forgotten")
- Right to portability
- Right to object to processing
To exercise these rights: contact@milkbebe.fr
You may also lodge a complaint with the CNIL (cnil.fr).

sections.title: 8. Cookies and trackers
sections.content:
Two categories:
- Necessary (always on): cart, session, security.
- Subject to consent (refusable and changeable at any time): audience measurement and advertising — Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager, Meta Pixel, Google review widgets (Merchant Center / Customer Reviews). These trackers only fire after acceptance.

Processors / recipients: Stripe (payment), Supabase (database), Vercel (hosting), Resend (emails), Sendcloud (shipping), and — after consent — Google and Meta. Some involve transfers outside the EU framed by appropriate safeguards (standard contractual clauses).

Retention: browsing data purged beyond 13 months; consent kept 13 months; orders kept according to our accounting obligations.

You can change or withdraw your consent at any time via the "Manage my cookies" link at the bottom of the page.

sizeguide.h1: Baby size guide: from birth to 6 months
sizeguide.intro: Choosing the right size means avoiding two headaches: the outfit that's too big and swamps baby, and the one you never use because it's already too small. Here's how to get it right, from hospital to 6 months.

sections.p: Clothing size is based on length, not age. Two babies the same age can differ noticeably in build. Measure your baby lying down, from head to heels with legs extended. That's the figure that matters.

If you're packing the hospital bag without knowing the birth weight, take both Newborn AND 0-3 months. Babies grow fast — 0-3 often fits within the first few weeks. For a baby expected to be big, or a baby born past their due date, go straight for 0-3.
Avoid Newborn (outgrown too fast). 3-6 months is the smart pick: baby will wear it longer, and it's rarely what parents buy first.

faq.q: Baby is between two sizes — which do I pick?
faq.a: The bigger one. A little room is better than a garment that's too tight.

faq.q: Does bamboo shrink in the wash?
What's the difference between Newborn and 0-3 months?
faq.a: About 10 cm and a full kilo. Newborn is cut for the first few weeks; 0-3 takes over quickly.

faq.hero_desc: Everything you want to know about M!LK, bamboo, shipping and our products.

questions.q: Why bamboo rather than cotton?
questions.r: Bamboo is naturally thermo-regulating, antibacterial and 3× softer. It absorbs moisture faster than cotton, regulates body temperature and contains fewer allergens. Ideal for a newborn's skin, which is 5× thinner than ours.

questions.q: What is the fabric made of?
questions.r: 95% bamboo viscose for softness, breathability and temperature regulation. 5% elastane for 4-way stretch: the garment follows baby's movements without constricting, and keeps its shape wash after wash.

questions.q: Is M!LK bamboo certified?
questions.r: Yes. Every M!LK batch is OEKO-TEX Standard 100 certified — the most demanding textile certification, testing over 100 harmful substances. Zero compromise.

questions.q: Does bamboo shrink in the wash?
questions.r: Our products are pre-washed. Wash at 30°C, gentle cycle, dry flat. Softness and shape are preserved indefinitely.

questions.q: Is bamboo suitable for babies with eczema?
questions.r: Yes. Bamboo microfibres are round and smooth. Naturally hypoallergenic and antibacterial — recommended for sensitive and atopic skin.

questions.q: Can I machine-wash M!LK clothing?
questions.r: Yes. Machine wash at 30°C, gentle cycle. Avoid fabric softener — it clogs the fibres and reduces bamboo's breathability.

questions.q: What are the delivery times?
questions.r: Orders placed before 4pm: same-day shipping (business days). Colissimo: 2-3 business days (home or pickup point). An email with the tracking number is sent as soon as the order ships.

questions.q: Is delivery free?
questions.r: Yes, free delivery from €60 in mainland France (excl. overseas territories). Below that, shipping fees are shown at checkout.

questions.q: Do you ship outside France?
questions.r: Yes: within mainland France (Monaco included, at the metropolitan rate) and to 21 European Union countries. International shipping fees are shown at checkout.

questions.q: Can I track my order?
questions.r: Yes. An email with the Colissimo tracking number is sent as soon as the order ships. Track it on laposte.fr or in your profile area.

questions.q: Can I return an item?
questions.r: Yes, within 14 days of receipt. The item must be unworn and in its original condition. Contact us at contact@milkbebe.fr to start a return. Return shipping is at the customer's expense (Colissimo recommended).

questions.q: How do I cancel an order?
questions.r: Contact us as soon as possible at contact@milkbebe.fr. If the order hasn't shipped yet, we can cancel it. After shipping, a return is the only option.

questions.q: My item is defective — what should I do?
questions.r: Send a photo to contact@milkbebe.fr. We replace or refund immediately, no questions asked. Quality is our core commitment.

questions.q: Can I order without creating an account?
questions.r: For now, an account is required to complete an order. Guest checkout is coming soon.

questions.q: How do I choose the right size?
questions.r: Newborn: up to ~3 kg. 0-3 months: 3 to 6 kg. 3-6 months: 6 to 9 kg. When in doubt, go one size up — bamboo adapts. Size charts are available on every product page.

questions.q: Is M!LK clothing suitable for premature babies?
questions.r: Our sizes start at Newborn (up to 3 kg). For premature babies, contact us — we have advice based on birth weight.

questions.q: How are M!LK products made?
questions.r: Our essentials are designed with care for the details that matter: smart openings, silent closures, flat anti-chafing seams, built-in mittens. Every product solves a real problem for an exhausted parent.

questions.q: Are the patterns available in all sizes?
questions.r: Yes. All our patterns (Lightning, Smileys, Checkerboard) are available in every size, while stocks last. Stock is limited — if it's sold out, you can set a restock alert.

questions.q: Which payment methods do you accept?
questions.r: Card (Visa, Mastercard, Amex), Apple Pay, Google Pay. All payments are secured via Stripe — your card details never pass through our servers.

questions.q: Is my data secure?
questions.r: Yes. Stripe payment (PCI-DSS certified), customer data stored on Supabase with encryption at rest. We never sell your data — it is only used to process your order and send your M!LK emails if you've opted in.

questions.q: Can I use a promo code?
questions.r: Yes. The promo code applies at the cart step, before payment. One code per order. Codes have an expiry date shown in the confirmation email.

about.title: About us
about.mom_p1: And I still remember those mornings in pyjamas — both of them cuddled against me, warm, smiling, the world still a little blurry. Those moments when nothing else exists.
about.mom_p2: In that everyday life, intense and gentle at once — where everything moves fast, everything is new, and you just look for simple things. A piece you grab without thinking, slip on in two seconds, and that is just… perfect. For them. For us.
about.block_p1: No overload. Nothing superfluous. Essentials with character — modern, unisex, different — for little ones who already deserve something a bit unusual.
about.block_p2: My boys have grown up. And with them, I learned. I learned what I would have loved to find from day one. That's M!LK — years of dreams, glances and longings, finally put into practice.
about.block_p3: We start with 0-6 months. But the vision is far bigger.
about.block_support: Support us — the most beautiful projects are coming.
about.values_sub: Just what matters when you're exhausted.
about.fab_intro: I discovered bamboo in the United States, long before M!LK existed. Not in a report, not in a study — I wore it. The softness, the way it holds warmth without stifling — I knew that was what I wanted for newborns.
about.fab_partner_p1: To learn who truly makes things well, I traced back the brands I admired. I reached out to several workshops. I turned most of them down — too much guesswork, not enough rigour.
about.fab_partner_p2: I chose a partner able to work a premium bamboo and to see me through to certification. Our fabrics don't carry a label inherited from someone else — I had them tested and OEKO-TEX certified myself.
about.fab_closing: I'll say it plainly: our clothes are woven and made abroad, at a partner I chose and vetted myself. Everything else — the patterns, the cuts, the finishing, the parcels you receive — comes from Menton.
about.fab_notwanted_p1: Patterns that look like everyone else's. Teddy bears, little hearts. I have two children — I'd have loved to find something else.
about.fab_notwanted_p2: Launching twenty products at once. We start with 0–6 months, where the nights are hardest. The rest will come when it's ready.
about.philo_quote_l1: Button-up pyjamas? A guaranteed battle at every change.
about.philo_quote_l2: Separate mittens? They get lost, fall off, disappear right when baby needs them most.
about.philo_p1: Here, every M!LK product solves a real problem. Fewer movements, less struggle, fewer things to manage. The evening routine becomes smooth, not stressful.
about.philo_p2: No pointless features. Just what matters when you're exhausted.
about.cta_desc: Essentials designed for the first 6 months. OEKO-TEX certified bamboo.

valeurs.titre: Every product solves a real problem.
valeurs.texte: No design for design's sake. No pointless features. We start from a concrete problem — getting dressed turning into a fight, overheating, lost mittens — and look for the simplest solution.
No excessive seasonal collections. We perfect the pieces that really matter: bodysuit, pyjama, sleep bag. The ones you use every day, several times a day.
Every product starts with a question: is this fabric really better for baby's skin? Bamboo isn't a trend. It's the most functional answer we found.

valeurs.titre: Made by parents, for exhausted parents.
valeurs.texte: We've lived the struggles. The bodysuits that don't open easily at 3am. The overheating. The irritation. The 15 snaps to line up while baby wriggles. We fixed them.
